external_target_opening_rule: Complete target-bearing files, pages, frames, worksheets and archive members may be opened only after this specification and a complete value-free source-record identity registry are byte-sealed.

required_topology.complete_transport_reaction_path: One source-resolved path must retain separated reactants, every transport-stage occurrence, the encounter boundary and the product-forming occurrence in order.
required_topology.finite_boundary: Transport is represented only by exact retained state-transition occurrences; no continuum field or differential diffusion law may enter the candidate grammar.
required_topology.transport_reaction_composition: The terminal transport occurrence must be the exact entry boundary of the reaction occurrence, with neither stage omitted or conflated.
required_topology.complete_external_surface: Article, supplements, both movies, reporting record, Nature source-data archive and independent Figshare metadata/archive identities are required without selecting favorable values.

selection_basis_before_target_opening: The open primary study was selected because its public abstract and source topology disclose controllable initial reactant separation, time-resolved transport followed by complex formation, multiple complete droplet-size reaction traces, two supplementary movies, complete supplementary material and independently hosted source data. The selection is observationally disclosed. No numerical distance, time, velocity, yield, rate, fitted distribution, uncertainty or source-data value may enter the Fold law or candidate decision.
